title: Zeus Juice Bar Liq Blueberry Sour Razz Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Zeus Juice Bar Liq Blueberry Sour Razz is a vibrant berry blend that balances sweetness with a sharp, tangy edge. The profile begins with the rich, juicy taste of ripe Blueberry, which is quickly met by the electrifying zing of Sour Raspberry. This interplay of sweet and sour notes creates a dynamic vaping experience, amplified by the double-concentrated formula for a taste that is consistently intense and satisfying. Mixed to a 50VG/50PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid is optimised for use with low-powered MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) hardware, such as pod vape kits and pen-style starter devices. The use of nicotine salts ensures a smooth throat hit and efficient nicotine satisfaction, even at higher strengths. For the best performance and flavour delivery, it is recommended to pair this e-liquid with coils or pods ranging between 0.6ohm and 1.2ohm. Bar Liq by the renowned UK manufacturer Zeus Juice is a collection of double-concentrated nicotine salts designed to deliver maximum flavour intensity. Known as "bar salts," these e-liquids are formulated with twice the flavour concentrate of standard blends, offering an intensely bold and vivid taste profile. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths, Bar Liq provides a smooth and satisfying vape experience.
